entities.name: Lev Oshanin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lev Ivanovich Oshanin was a Soviet poet, songwriter, author of over 70 books of poetry, novels and poetry plays, winner of the Stalin Prize of the first degree (1950) and winner of the World Festival of Youth and Students.
